# Support

## Before you ask

Start with [Getting started](../docs/guide/getting-started.md), the [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md) page and the [CLI reference](../docs/reference/cli.md).

## Questions and bugs

- **Bug or unexpected behavior:** open an issue with the
  [bug report form](https://github.com/andryorelabs/emet/issues/new/choose).
- **Feature or improvement ideas:** open an issue with the feature or
  enhancement form.
- **Documentation problems:** open an issue with the documentation form.

## Security

Do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities. Follow
[`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).

## Response expectations

emet is maintained by a single person. Issues are triaged on a
best-effort basis and there is no guaranteed response time.
